chosen_titles.rationale: Louisiana Revised Statutes contain BOTH lobbying-disclosure regimes: La. R.S. Title 24 Ch. 2 (Legislative Lobbyist Disclosure Act, §§24:50-63) and La. R.S. Title 49 Ch. 1 Part XIV (Executive Branch Lobbying Disclosure Act, §§49:71-83). Civil Code is private law and is intentionally excluded.

notes: LA top-level Justia index lists codes (Revised Statutes, Children's Code, Civil Code, Code of Civil Procedure, Code of Criminal Procedure, Code of Evidence), not titles. Both lobbying regimes live inside Revised Statutes (Title 24 legislative + Title 49 executive), so pass-1 returns the single Revised Statutes URL; the two-body selection is performed at pass-2 by cascading through revised-statutes/ to title-24/ and title-49/.
